name: Mission Viejo Library Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Write posts for the Teen Voice Blog from home, or drop in to the Teen Volunteer Club at the library. Each blog post earns 1 service hour, or 2 if you write about an event you went to.
who_can_apply: Teen Volunteer Club is for grades 6 to 12. The page lists no age or home rules for the Teen Voice Blog.
pay_detail: Volunteer. You earn community service hours.
duration: Blog is ongoing. Club meets the fourth Thursday, January to October, 6 to 8 p.m.
deadline_text: Teen Voice Blog sign-ups are ongoing. The club has no November or December meetings on its posted schedule. Teen Advisory Board info event: Dec 9, 2026, 4:30 to 5:30 p.m.
how_to_apply: For the blog, fill out the application linked on the program page. For the club, just come. No sign-up or training is needed. Questions: libvolunteers@cityofmissionviejo.org.
notes: The Teen Advisory Board is for grades 9 to 12. It meets once a month to plan teen programs. City pages do not agree on its dates, and one still lists June 15 to July 31 with no year. Go to the Dec 9 event or call 949-452-8342. The library is at 100 Civic Center.
